_comment: Settings that did not exist in the previous build: the model loop, the MCP data layer, and cycle timing. Strategy thresholds are NOT here -- underlyings, delta range, DTE range, spread widths, exits and execution live in options_config.json, and the nine risk-gate thresholds live in risk_config.json. Those two files are what the ported modules read, and duplicating any value here would create a second source of truth that silently disagrees.
_max_turns_note: 8, not the 5 originally planned. A real research pass costs clock -> account -> positions -> chain -> snapshots before a proposal is even possible, so 5 risks exhausting the budget before the model can propose anything. Note the model issues tool calls in PARALLEL (observed: get_clock and get_account_info in one turn), so a turn is not the same as a tool call. turns_used is journalled every cycle so this is tuned from observed data.
_cycle_timeout_note: Wall-clock ceiling per ticker. Validated at load to stay below cycle_interval_seconds, so a hung provider cannot stall the next cron run.

llm._selection_note: Groq is primary. OpenRouter was removed: its free tier caps free-model calls per day well below what a 5-minute cadence across three underlyings needs, so cycles would have silently failed over mid-session anyway. Groq's free tier is far more generous and gpt-oss-120b passed the same two-tool round-trip harness (spikes/gate_stage2.py) that every candidate was measured against.
llm._reinstating_openrouter: To put it back, set provider/model to openrouter and a ':free' model that passed the survey -- nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free was the largest. Re-run `python spikes/gate_stage2.py --survey` first; free model availability changes without notice.

chain._feed_note: Passed explicitly on every options call. The MCP tool schema defaults to 'opra', and an account without a signed OPRA agreement gets 403 'OPRA agreement is not signed' rather than a silent downgrade to the free feed. Omitting this one word fails 100% of option calls.
chain._bracket_note: Fraction of spot to bracket the chain request with. Generous on purpose: the -0.15..-0.20 delta window is not a fixed distance from spot, it moves with IV and DTE, so a bracket tuned in a mid-IV regime returns nothing in a low-IV week. Widening this is the fix for a bracket_too_narrow event.
chain._limit_note: get_option_chain truncates a STRIKE-ASCENDING ordering. An unbracketed SPY put chain starts near strike 420 against a spot of 765, so a small limit returns only worthless deep-OTM contracts, none of which carry Greeks at all.

_cadence_note: Matches the crontab. Fifteen minutes rather than five because Groq's free tier caps tokens-per-minute at 8,000 and one ticker costs 6,000-12,000 across its turns; at five minutes three underlyings saturate the window continuously and no cycle ever finishes.
